about: Labeled route families for the agentic execution router (docs/api/2026-10-02-agentic-execution-router.md, section 5 and 13; #10205). Seeded from the chat router fixtures: every wallet-v1 row (#10170, defaults before questions), every coder_followup row of routes-v4 (#10171), and up to three tune and three held-out rows per other chat route; new rows cover dispatch plans (#10183), issue work, continuation and steering, standing rules (#10157), plugin creation (#10177), local commands, and defaults. routes-v4 held_out rows are test here; tune on tune rows only. expect is the family-specific detail a correct route also needs.
